newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: South Korea president to visit Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: South Korea president to visit Malaysia.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young Sam arrives in Malaysia on Tuesday for a three-day visit which is expected to feature talks with Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.
It will be Kim's first official trip to Malaysia.

As part of his visit, representatives of the Korean Stock Exchange on Thursday will sign a memorandum of understanding with the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) to promote cooperation between the exchanges, the KLSE said in a statement.
Trade between the two countries has risen an annual average 27.6 percent since 1990. Trade totaled $5.4 billion in 1995, up 54 percent from the previous year.
Korea's main exports to Malaysia are electric and electronic products, machinery, transportation equipment, iron, steel, and other metal products.
Malaysia exports agricultural and marine products as well as electric and electronics products to Korea.
